title: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2.4 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands due to…
description: IBM Guardium Data Protection version 12.2.4 contains a vulnerability that could allow a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands. This is due to improper neutralization of argument delimiters, which may enable command injection. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.7, indicating a medium severity level. No specific affected versions beyond 12.2.4 are stated, and no patch information is provided.
